verdict.rationale: A built-in AI agent is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, but nothing in the evidence shows kitty shipping one that plans and runs commands with user approval. Its remote-control interface, verified hands-on, only lets an external agent drive kitty. That is a developer building block, not a built-in agent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate terminal tasks to a built-in AI agent that plans and executes commands with my approval
